documents.title: Kennesaw State University Artificial Intelligence Policy
documents.quality_note: Formal institution-wide policy covering governance, approval of AI tools, ethical principles and an annual AI training module for students and employees. It defers details to the KSU Institutional AI Guidance Document, which was not found separately.

documents.title: Sample Syllabus Statements on AI Use
documents.quality_note: University-provided templates for AI Use Prohibited / Allowed / Required, with the expectation that faculty state an AI policy in every syllabus section. Model language, not a binding rule.

documents.unit: College of Computing and Software Engineering (CCSE), First Year Experience
documents.title: CCSE FYE Policies (Academic Misconduct: AI & Cheating)
documents.quality_note: College-run policies for the first-year programming course sequence (CSE 1321/1322). Work must be written 'without the use of AI'; using AI on any lab, assignment, quiz or exam is academic misconduct, and exam rules say 'Student MAY NOT use AI.' It is a short AI/cheating section within a longer page and applies to FYE courses only.

notes: Computing-unit layer: the CCSE FYE page is the closest college-level computing policy and is recorded as school layer; no separate CS or Software Engineering department AI policy was found. The CETL 'AI and Academic Integrity' page (campus.kennesaw.edu/faculty-staff/cetl/teaching-resources/ai-and-teaching/academic-integrity.php) was fetched but is a resource list with no rules, so it was not collected. The sample syllabus PDFs under dli.kennesaw.edu and www.kennesaw.edu/radow are course-template documents and were not collected.
